import json,hashlib,pathlib
import torch,cutlass,cutlass.cute as cute
import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
from cutlass import Float32,Int32,Int64,Uint32,Uint8
from cutlass.cute.runtime import from_dlpack
from b12x._lib.intrinsics import quantize_block_fp8_mx,max_abs_32,fmax_f32,pow2_ceil_ue8m0_torch
class Quant:
 @cute.jit
 def __call__(self,x:cute.Tensor,y:cute.Tensor,s:cute.Tensor,blocks:Int32,stream:cuda.CUstream):
  self.kernel(x,y,s,blocks).launch(grid=(cute.ceil_div(blocks,128),1,1),block=(128,1,1),stream=stream)
 @cute.kernel
 def kernel(self,x:cute.Tensor,y:cute.Tensor,s:cute.Tensor,blocks:Int32):
  block=Int64(cute.arch.block_idx()[0])*Int64(128)+Int64(cute.arch.thread_idx()[0])
  if block<Int64(blocks):
   vals=cute.make_rmem_tensor((32,),Float32)
   for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(32):vals[j]=Float32(x[block*Int64(32)+Int64(j)])
   payload,scale=quantize_block_fp8_mx(vals,fmax_f32(max_abs_32(vals),Float32(1e-4)))
   for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):y[block*Int64(8)+Int64(j)]=payload[j]
   s[block]=Uint8(scale)
def tensor(x,dtype):
 t=from_dlpack(x,assumed_align=16);t.element_type=dtype;return t

for case in [0,1]:
 raw=pathlib.Path(f'/inputs/{case}-hidden.bin').read_bytes()
 x=torch.frombuffer(bytearray(raw),dtype=torch.bfloat16).cuda()
 y=torch.empty(x.numel()//4,dtype=torch.int32,device='cuda')
 scales=torch.empty(x.numel()//32,dtype=torch.uint8,device='cuda')
 args=(tensor(x,cutlass.BFloat16),tensor(y,Uint32),tensor(scales,Uint8))
 stream=cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
 f=cute.compile(Quant(),*args,Int32(x.numel()//32),stream)
 f(*args,Int32(x.numel()//32),stream)
 wire=torch.cat([y.view(torch.uint8).reshape(80,5120),scales.reshape(80,160)],dim=1)
 torch.cuda.synchronize()
 raw=wire.cpu().numpy().tobytes()
 pathlib.Path(f'/encoded/{case}-hidden.bin').write_bytes(raw)
 for name in ['ids','routing']:
  pathlib.Path(f'/encoded/{case}-{name}.bin').write_bytes(pathlib.Path(f'/inputs/{case}-{name}.bin').read_bytes())
 print(json.dumps({'case':case,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}),flush=True)
